about-school.html.title: - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Devasthaly Vidyapeeth was founded on the 2nd October 1988 with the prime aim of imparting a comprehensive modern education to the children with valuable Indian tradition of education , irrespective of caste, creed and community. "Devasthaly Vidyapeeth was established under the vision of our founder, Ex-Prime Minister of India, Mr. Chandra Shekhar ."

The institute is located in plush premises at Devasthaly, surrounded by attractive healthy, natural environment that creates favourable academic conditions for alround development of children. Since the day of inception it has been determined to scale an unparalleled new graph of success to impart it to the children.

We want our children to imbibe moral values in life. At present the rapid changes in technology and accelerated pace of privatisation and liberalisation created a new sense of uncertainity about the future of society. Thus education should respond meaningfully and effectively to address the crucial academic burning issues. Devasthaly Vidyapeeth in its efforts is providing need-based quality education to the blossoming knowledge which has decided to equip the children will pragmatic skills so that they can face the future with renewed confidence and matchless courage. The president of school is always nurturing the institute keeping sight and presenting all the facilities with help of management committee.

founders-message.html.title: Founder's Message - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Shri Chandra Shekhar was born on April 17, 1927, in a farmer’s family in village Ibrahimpatti in District Ballia, Uttar Pradesh. He was President of the Janata Party from 1977 to 1988. Shri Chandra Shekhar was attracted to politics from his student days and was known as a fire-brand idealist with revolutionary fervour. After his Master’s Degree in Political Science from Allahabad University (1950-51), he joined the Socialist Movement. He had the privilege of having been associated very closely with Acharya Narendra Dev. He was elected Secretary of the District Praja Socialist Party, Ballia. Within a year, he was elected Joint Secretary of the U.P. State Praja Socialist Party. In 1955-56 he took over as General Secretary of the U.P., State Praja Socialist Party. In 1962, he was elected to the Rajya Sabha from Uttar Pradesh. He joined the Indian National Congress in January 1965. In 1967 he was elected General Secretary of the Congress Parliamentary Party. As a Member of Parliament he made a mark by taking keen interest in espousing the cause of the downtrodden and pleading for policies for rapid social change. In this context, when he attacked the disproportionate growth of monopoly houses with State patronage, he came in conflict with the centres of power.Chandra Shekhar (8th Prime Minister of India, 1990–1991) was known as a "Young Turk" and a steadfast socialist leader who championed the cause of the poor, farmers, and the downtrodden. His vision was defined by ideological politics, grassroots connection, and a commitment to democratic values over personality-driven leadership.

patrons-message.html.title: Patron's Message - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: My father late Chandrashekhar Ji would always dream of progressing his native land in multidirection specially in the field of education.

It was an inevitable need of that time of the district and purvanchal along with neighboring states which he brought to a concrete form establishing this institute in the year 1988 with the services for day as well as boarding students.
Since then it has been inclined to achieve his desired motive providing its best services to make the students consummate in their life and to ensure their benefaction for the nation building.

It is a motif of grandiose to me that I have been inherited the devoir to patron the institution. Its my meliorism that I would be able to keep my father’s vision with the reinforcement of trust worthy guardians and common man.
Neeraj Shekhar
Member of Rajyasabha

presidents-message.html.title: President's Message - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Devasthaly Vidyapeeth, was one of the dream project of my Baba (Late Chandrashekhar Ji) because he believes that educational Institutions are the last rayof hope for the humanity. I would like to quote one of his statements through which we would feel his approach about children who are not getting proper nourishment and putting a big question mark to the society.
Ravishankar Singh
M.L.C

managers-message.html.title: Manager's Message - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: About 38 years ago Late Shri Chandrashekhar (Founder of Devasthaly) thoughts shaped a line "A child is an ocean of immense possibilities and it is our noble duty to fish-out pearls for them". Of course, every child possesses unique inherent quality but latent talents not elsewhere found in conjecture. Its utilisation needs alert parental care at home and continuous inspiration, encouragement, environment clubbed with timely redressal of problems at school. Teacher's responsibility is to inculcate moral values, self-realisation, patience, restrain, tolerance and dutifulness to build a sound character, besides academic enhancement, variable excellence and personality development. This must be done consistantly, as per child's needs which always differs from child to child. Students must set a goal of life based on merits and mental inclination and not on glamoured choices. Therefore, choice of a child must not be rediculed. Its hostilities must be weeded out by psycho counselling. Children are tender, to them cruelty and hurting remarks are shocking. Our aim is to make them good, smart, dynamic, alert, honest, dutiful, dispilined, compassionate and caring. They need us. So do we. In such a situation orignal thoughts and ideas (which are changing face of globe) will come forth like water from a fountain. Efforts should innovative coupled with classical method of learning. Technology and audio-visual devices too should be accomodated to bring out inner potentional of students. Hence, inspiration will be the point of origin. Our students should be versatile and good in math, music and marathon.
Dr. Naveen Singh
Manager

principals-message.html.title: Principal's Message - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Devasthaly Vidyapeeth is an amalgamation of competent teachers, state-of-the-art infrastructure, an idyllic setting and an experienced and efficient administration. The school came into existence with the vision of creating a safe and supportive environment for its students – to provide a perfect balance of academics, sports, artistic and social opportunities. Childhood, youth and learning should be a joy and we strive for that.

Devasthaly Vidyapeeth aims at holistic growth and development of its students. The school's genuine concern ensures student's emotional growth along with intellectual excellence. This empowers them to develop their self esteem, self-awareness and self-confidence. Sharing ideas, analysing situations and expressing them confidently are essential skills which are honed here, through experiential learning. The school takes leadership seriously and our concern for character is a point of distinction. Our mission has never been narrow to prepare students for college, but rather to provide an experience which goes far beyond college requirements, addressing important personal aspects of growth and maturity.

Modern and secure infrastructure, pollution free environment, excellent pastoral care, nutritious and sumptuous vegetarian food are some of our strengths. While studying at Devasthaly Vidyapeeth, your ward is groomed to become a confident, articulate and enlightened young citizen, ready to step into global society with dignity, honour and integrity.

We believe in giving our students deep roots along with a set of strong wings which may carry them far and wide but still continue nourishing with rich moral values. In other words, our students are equipped to face the challenges of the rapidly changing world.
P. C. Shrivastava Principal

general-insructions.html.title: General Insructions - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: 1. Attendance in prayer, physical training, social service assignments, sports and games, Yoga and Meditation classes and extension lecture of Saturday etc. is compulsory. Absence in any one of them would be treated as absent for the whole days and student fined accordingly.
2. Students coming late will not be allowed to attend classes.
3. Parents and servants also will not be allowed to meet a student during school hours. In special cases and emergencies they would be required to contact the Principal and seek permission.
4. Every student must be present on the day the school reopens after each vacation.
5. Parents are advised to plan their holidays according to the vacation fixed by the school.
6. It is also advisable that parents do not disturb their child to attend weddings and other functions during the academic period.
7. No student can leave school premises during school hours without the written permission of the Principal.
8. The Principal has right to suspend any student if his / her conduct and / or progress is not satisfactory.
9. Suggestions / complaints, if any, should be lodged in writing and in confidence to the Principal.

vision-and-mission.html.title: Vision and Mission - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: To meet a long-felt need of providing quality educational facilities to our younger children, Devasthaly Vidyapeeth, Devasthaly, Ballia has been opened. The School is located 8kms. away from Rasra or 25kms. away from Ballia on Ballia-Lucknow State Highway.

The School was started on Oct., 2, 1988. It is an English medium institution co-educational and prepares students for CBSE examination. This institution aims at all round physical, mental moral and spiritual development of the child. Special care is taken to make the child a useful member of the society.

academic-system.html.title: Academic System - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: ASSESSMENT AND PROMOTION

• Promotions will be decided on the average marks obtained in the Terminal and Final Examinations in addition to the year’s work including the unit test. To pass in any subject, a student has to secure 35% marks except for languages. Any students who losses the progress card will be fined Rs. 25/-.
• Those students who are absent for any of the termination is punishable with expulsion from terminal/unit examination will not be tested earlier or later.
• Willful breach of any of the regulations for the conduct of Examination is punishable with expulsion from examination or if subsequently discovered cancelling of paper.
The Parents/Guardians of these students are free to come to the school and meet the class teachers to know the progress of their children/wards on this day.

admission-procedure.html.title: Admission Procedure - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Before admission child’s name has to be registered (16th January to 20th of March) in advance. A sum of Rs.1000/- is charged as registration fee for boarder and day scholar. The said payment is to done in form of Demand Draft (DD) in favour of "Principal Devasthaly, Devasthaly Ballia", Payable at Ballia, Along with application form.
✓ No admission will be granted to the student unless a transfer certificate from the previous institution is produced along with application form
✓ Formal admission is completed after the perusal of the application form by the principal and the parents are informed of his decision after a test and an interview
✓ Every student will have to produce a birth certificate from from the Hospital, Nursing home, The Municipality or the Gram Panchayat
✓ The child must have attained the age of four years at the time of admission in L.K.G.
✓ If the child fails for two successive years he/ she will not allowed to continue his/her education in this institute

co-curricular-activities.html.title: Co-Curricular Activities - Devasthalyballia
paragraphs: Devasthaly Vidyapeeth provides a wide variety of extra-curricular activities catering to each individual’s needs, talents and interest. Devasthaly Vidyapeeth works towards enhancing the personality of each child for all-round development, thereby nurturing the students to become a global citizen, who can compete and reside worldwide. Devasthaly Vidyapeeth, at regular intervals organises different activities and competitions in its separately built up area of 22000 sq ft.

Devasthaly Vidyapeeth encourages its students to have a balanced involvement in the academic and extra curricular activities. Students are exposed to dance, music and other cultural events by number of inter House competitions and club activities including fine arts, computer graphics, nature club, vocal & instrumental music, western & Indian classical dance, house keeping and cooking club.
